mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a negative 20-day forward return in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which is typically associated with higher economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases significantly but does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% MoM but does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM but does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously but do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals accommodative monetary policy in the face of inflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases simultaneously but do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 5% YoY but does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and INDPRO increases simultaneously but do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the cases.
